title: Treatment Of Short Stature With Genotropin In Children Born Small For Gestational Age Until Final Height
brief_summary: This trial evaluates whether long-term treatment with Genotropin normalizes final (adult) height in short children born small for gestational age
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participation in the 90-080 study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any severe, acute or chronic disease
* Any other identifiable reason for short stature
